text.t1: Cicero now translates the record across languages.
text.t33: Matter analysis for claims, disputes and investigations
text.t35: Every document in its own language. The case in yours
text.t36: Cross-border disputes rarely run in one language. The contract is in one, the correspondence in another, and the witness statements in both. Cicero translates documents from and into the languages your matters run in, and builds one matter from all of them.
text.t39: Languages include Arabic, Chinese, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Swedish, Polish, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, Indonesian and English.
text.t44: Employer says possession of the site was given
text.t45: يقول صاحب العمل إن حيازة الموقع سُلِّمت
text.t48: Possession of the site was given on February 19, 2024.
text.t49: Possession of the site was given on February 19, 2024.
text.t53: نحيطكم علمًا بأن الموقع لم يُسلَّم إلى المقاول إلا بتاريخ 3 مارس 2024.
text.t54: We advise that the site was not handed over to the Contractor until March 3, 2024.
text.t57: تم تسليم الموقع إلى المقاول بتاريخ 3 مارس 2024 بحضور ممثل صاحب العمل.
text.t58: The site was handed over to the Contractor on March 3, 2024, in the presence of the Employer's representative.
text.t59: DOC-0391 · Site handover record, signed by both parties
text.t60: The Employer's witness gives February 19. Translated, two Arabic documents put the handover on March 3, 2024.
text.t62: يذكر شاهد صاحب العمل في إفادته المترجمة من الإنجليزية تاريخ 19 فبراير، بينما يحدد مستندان عربيان تاريخ التسليم في 3 مارس 2024.
text.t65: Two languages, one event, and a date nobody agrees on
text.t66: A chronology entry in Cicero. The Employer's witness statement, in English, puts the site handover on February 19, 2024. Translated from Arabic, the Engineer's letter and the signed handover record both say March 3. Cicero puts all three accounts on the same event and flags the conflict.
text.t67: Switch the reading language to Arabic and the same entry reads in Arabic, with every original still beside its translation.
text.t69: Built for records that cross languages
text.t71: Translate documents into the language your team works in, and work product into the language the tribunal wants.
text.t73: Documents are analyzed in the language they were written in, so propositions, events and key players come from the source text, not from a translation of it.
text.t75: Every translated passage stays linked to its original paragraph. When it matters what a document actually says, the source is one click away.
text.t77: Events draw on documents in every language in the record. When accounts in different languages disagree, the contradiction is flagged like any other.
text.t79: The languages your matters run in
text.t80: Translate documents between English and each of these languages. Working in one that isn't listed? Ask us.
text.t81: Available as an add-on in some jurisdictions, for documents a court or tribunal needs certified.
text.t120: In the Gulf, the contract is usually in Arabic and the correspondence usually isn't. Cicero translates from Arabic to English and from English to Arabic, analyzes Arabic documents in the original, and puts both languages on the same chronology.
text.t121: في الخليج، يكون العقد عادةً بالعربية بينما تكون المراسلات بغيرها. يترجم Cicero من العربية إلى الإنجليزية ومن الإنجليزية إلى العربية، ويحلل المستندات العربية بلغتها الأصلية، ويضع اللغتين على تسلسل زمني واحد.
text.t123: Letter, Engineer to Contractor · Translated from Arabic
text.t124: We advise that the site was not handed over to the Contractor until March 3, 2024, after the clearance works were completed.
text.t127: نحيطكم علمًا بأن الموقع لم يُسلَّم إلى المقاول إلا بتاريخ 3 مارس 2024، وذلك بعد استكمال أعمال الإزالة.
text.t128: Accordingly, the completion period under clause 14.2 runs from that date.
text.t131: وعليه، فإن مدة الإنجاز المنصوص عليها في البند 14.2 تُحتسب اعتبارًا من هذا التاريخ.

text.t136: A translation that knows what it means for the case
text.t137: An Arabic letter, translated paragraph by paragraph. Its second paragraph gives a handover date that contradicts the Employer's English witness statement. Cicero puts both accounts on the same event and flags the conflict.
text.t141: The disputes where language costs the most time

text.t145: Interviews, emails and messages in several languages, tested against each other for consistency.
text.t147: Contracts, site correspondence and expert reports in different languages. Delay and payment disputes turn on dates buried across all of them.
